name: dsh-usage-badge
description: DeepSeek Harness 用量徽标插件：左下角 ¥ 胶囊显示当日估算费用，点击查看 24 小时 / 近 7 日 / 近 30 日 / 近 12 个月用量与金额，按 provider 筛选。只读 DSH 会话日志，价格表沿用 $DSH_HOME/storages/usage-pricing.json。A lean cost badge plugin for DeepSeek Harness: a ¥ pill showing today's estimated spend, with 24h / 7d / 30d / 12-month charts.

scripts.test: node test/manifest.verify.mjs && node test/pricing.verify.mjs && node test/holidays.verify.mjs && node test/official-pricing.verify.mjs && node test/client.render.mjs
